dup.color.rate.unit: USD per page (any paper copy not larger than 9x14 inches; no color distinction)
dup.color.rate.notes: No color-specific rate anywhere in ch. 610, the AG Sunshine Law book, or case law found. 'Pictures ... graphics, illustrations or similar ... visual items' in § 610.026.1(2) covers photographic/graphic ORIGINALS, not a color photocopy of an ordinary paper record.

rules.freePages.notes: No free-page allowance in § 610.026 (opened in full), ch. 610, or the AG Sunshine Law book. Fees are chargeable from page one; the only relief is the discretionary public-interest waiver (MO-0024/MO-9006).

labor.increment.notes: No billing increment or rounding rule in § 610.026 (opened in full), ch. 610, or the AG Sunshine Law book. City sets its own increment; 'actual cost' and the lowest-cost-staff duty (MO-0021) argue against coarse round-ups.

rules.freeLaborHours.label: Free labor hours per request
rules.freeLaborHours.notes: No free-labor-hours allowance per request in § 610.026 (opened in full), ch. 610, or the AG book (contrast e.g. Tenn./Kan. patterns). Labor is chargeable from the first minute; relief only via the discretionary public-interest waiver.

media.label: Electronic media (CD/DVD/USB) charge
media.notes: Medium charge = 'the cost of the disk, tape, or other medium used for the duplication' — actual cost, no fixed rate. A flat uniform per-copy media fee not built from the three components is unlawful: R.L. Polk & Co. v. Mo. Dep't of Revenue, 309 S.W.3d 881 (Mo. App. W.D. 2010).

Research time required for fulfilling records requests may be charged at the actual cost of research time.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: Documents must be copied/duplicated using the personnel of the body that results in the lowest amount of charges for the request.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: Fees for records maintained on computer facilities, tapes, disks, videotapes or films shall include only the cost of copies, staff time (not exceeding the average hourly rate of pay for staff needed for copies and programming), and the cost of the medium used for duplication.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: Each public governmental body must appoint a custodian who is responsible for the maintenance of that body's records.
The identity and location of a public governmental body's custodian must be made available upon request.

payment.advance_payment.summary: Payment of fees may be requested prior to fulfilling the request.
